x: We have a few new performers: one, Murray, a Shot and Discus man, who is a fireman, and he should strengthen our teams. We shall also be glad to welcome back to the fold Arthur Allen who has now finished his Army service.

We hope Bergvalds will get better support and look to Arthur Allen and Dennis Childs for this, as we cannot expect Bill Sutton to go on for ever. Murray and Cornell should show improvement in the Shot. The Javelin was last year one of our weakest events.
I wonder how necessary it was for Dunphy and Murray (Hercules), Kortenray(Wimbledon) Smallbone (Epsom and Ewell) and--almost--Collins (Surrey) to change their's.

Leading from the gun with Murray with him, he broke away to win by 2½ minutes. Results; 1.G.Seatter 2:26.56; 2.M.Day 2:29.36; 3.A.King (Leic.) 2:30.09; 12.C.Lawton 2:43.08; 22.J.Newnham 2:53.26; 33.J.Dunsford 3:05.05.
